text:
🎥 Shobhit, is hafte ek shoot (sabse zyada reach real proof se aati hai):

PAANI TEST: ek ply ka tukda aur ek VAJRA sheet ka tukda, dono raat bhar paani ki balti mein. Subah nikaal ke camera ke saamne dikhao: ply phool gaya, VAJRA waisi hi.

• Phone khada (vertical), din ki roshni
• 20-30 sec, ek hi shot mein
• Bolna ho to: 'Raat bhar paani mein rakha. Ply dekho, aur VAJRA dekho.'

Yahin group mein bhej dena, reel apne aap ban jayegi.
